title: Mahjong Solitaire
short_description: Calm 3D mahjong solitaire — clear the classic turtle of 144 ivory tiles by matching free pairs, with hints and a solvable shuffle.
description: An unhurried game of mahjong solitaire rendered in clean 3D. The 144 tiles are stacked into the classic turtle: circles, bamboo, characters, winds, dragons, flowers and seasons in carved ivory. Remove tiles two at a time by matching a FREE pair — a tile is free when nothing sits on top of it and its left or right side is open. Flowers match any flower and seasons match any season; everything else matches its twin. Every deal is generated solvable, so a patient player can always clear the board. Left-click a free tile, then its match. Stuck? Take a hint, or shuffle the remaining tiles into a fresh solvable layout. Warm light, gentle piano, no timer — just the quiet satisfaction of an emptying board.
controls_keyboard: Left-click a free tile, then its matching free tile to remove the pair · H hint · S shuffle · Right-drag rotate camera · scroll zoom · Esc pause · F3 debug
